name: Lazav
description: Lazav is the shapeshifting Guildmaster of House Dimir on Ravnica.

summary.text: Lazav is the shapeshifting Guildmaster of House Dimir on Ravnica.

bio.text: Lazav appears in Merret's armchair, orders Wothis to stay away from the family and magically bends his will.

citations.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.
"Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

bio.text: He offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, then scrambles the family's memories with his laugh.

citations.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.
"Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

bio.text: At the gathering of guild representatives he reveals that he was disguised as Varryvort.

citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

bio.text: Later pages show that Tolsimir believes a Dimir figure is still alive and planning something, and Proft insists the Dimir guildmaster is not truly gone.

status.text: As of the latest events, Lazav leads House Dimir, and in 2023 and 2024 characters believe he is still alive and not truly gone.

timeline.summary: Jace discovers the Bailiff and learns of the Supreme Verdict; Lazav also speaks to the Bailiff.
timeline.quote: As Jace left, Lazav also spoke to the bailiff to learn its secrets.

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Bailiff pronounces the Supreme Verdict; Jace links the runners' minds to prevent catastrophe and is named the new Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: the bailiff named Jace the new Living Guildpact

citation.text: "Forum of Azor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek's death, Lazav gathers what remains of the Dimir and has a new Duskmantle built.
timeline.quote: Lazav managed to gather what was left of the Dimir and bring them together.

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav attempts to exploit the Implicit Maze to make the maze-runners kill each other; Jace merges the champions' minds and is made the Living Guildpact, thwarting him.
timeline.quote: His plan to destroy the rival guilds and seize power for the Dimir was thwarted

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav cleanses his guild of Bolas's agents and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas at the guild summit.
timeline.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Selesnya march on the Rakdos and into the Boros Legion; Niv-Mizzet reveals the maze's secrets, Emmara is arrested for treason and learns from Jace that Lazav replaced Calomir.
timeline.quote: she learned that Lazav had taken Calomir's place months ago

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emmara exposes Lazav but sows dissent; she runs the maze with Jace until Ral Zarek makes Jace reveal his lies at the Izzet Guildgate.
timeline.quote: she lured Lazav and managed to expose him

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Forum of Azor Lazav influences the runners, but Jace's telepathy stops the Maze, triggering the Supreme Verdict that makes him Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: This triggered the Supreme Verdict , which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav reveals himself, sends Grimbly away with no memory, installs Aunt Bea and alters Merret and Tashi's memories.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, Lazav revealed himself from the corner where he had been sitting all along.

citation.text: "Grimbly Wothis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace links the maze-runners' minds and is declared the new Guildpact by the Bailiff.
timeline.quote: Jace connected their ten minds to prevent any from casting the verdict.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Return to Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav stalled Niv-Mizzet's experiments until his intentions were known.
timeline.quote: Lazav took every opportunity to stall his experiments.

citation.text: Psychic Strike (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past while Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched.
timeline.quote: While Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched, Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past.

citation.text: Serene Remembrance (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Boros are losing their angels to the Gateless Movement.
timeline.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

citation.text: Urbis Protector (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Isperia sentences Jace to community service; Jace links the runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming the first Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "Mazerunner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa completes the Implicit Maze but Lazav causes mayhem until Jace links the maze-runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and making him the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: this triggered the Supreme Verdict , which restored the Guildpact 's magic and empowered Jace as Ravnica's first Living Guildpact .

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Maze-runner". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Liric was elevated to Dimir remainder in a ceremony where a guildmage sealed his strand with a coin bearing Lazav's likeness.
timeline.quote: A symbol of the voided circle.

citation.text: "Last Day". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liric's father shows images in the sand, including Niv-Mizzet, Ral Zarek and a hooded figure in blue, and says Lazav believes the Dimir must have a prize.
timeline.quote: The guilds are poised to run the Implicit Maze.

citation.text: "Last Day". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Lazav tells that some guilds may have fallen under an invader's influence.
timeline.quote: We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

citation.text: Sinister Sabotage (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lazav finds and kills the infiltrators in his guild and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas.
timeline.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Guilds of Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Merret notices Lazav sitting in the armchair, and the baby takes his first steps into Lazav's arms.
timeline.quote: Could this be Lazav? Lazav the Mastermind, Guildmaster of House Dimir?

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Lazav orders Wothis to stay away from the family, and magically bends his will.
timeline.quote: Any outstanding debts Merret owes you will be paid in full by the close of business tomorrow

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
timeline.quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Lazav's laugh scrambles the family's memories so that Great Aunt Bea seems to be staying with them.
timeline.quote: Lazav laughs a raspy laugh, like stones scratching against rib bone.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Lazav warns that Dovin Baan came from nowhere and is more than he appears.
timeline.quote: This Dovin Baan came from nowhere.

citation.text: Senate Courier (Ravnica Allegiance, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lazav recruits Rat into the Dimir and brainwashes her into a secret assassin.
timeline.quote: Lazav periodically approached Rat in various forms as he slowly brainwashed the young girl

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Atkos Tarr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav sculpts the persona Atkos Tarr for Rat, who assassinates Dovin Baan.
timeline.quote: Lazav had Atkos Tarr assassinate Dovin Baan in his secret safe house on Ravnica .

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Atkos Tarr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra helps disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: This deception allowed the real Chandra to sneak into Baan's facility and disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark, Lazav, disguised as Chandra, blinds Dovin, who planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Lazav threw throwing stars that hit Dovin in the eyes and blinded him.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan returns to Ravnica and is assassinated by Atkos Tarr, sent by Lazav; Atkos secretly passes Baan's left hand to Lazav.
timeline.quote: only to be assassinated by Atkos Tarr who had been sent by Lazav in his plans to blackmail Vraska.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra so the real Chandra can disable the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Lazav disguised himself as Chandra, which allowed the real Chandra to disable the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav defeats Dovin Baan, leaving him blinded and forcing him to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: Lazav defeated Dovin and left him blinded, forcing him to planeswalk away

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav and the other guildmasters join Nissa's ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet with the power of the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Lazav participated in a ritual led by Nissa to resurrect Niv-Mizzet and grant him the power of the Living Guildpact

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Nissa, Saheeli, Lavinia and Lazav shut off the Immortal Sun at New Prahv after defeating Dovin Baan, using Azor's nine words.
timeline.quote: Chandra managed to shut it off with the spell

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark Lavinia helps shut off the Immortal Sun after defeating Dovin Baan.
timeline.quote: They managed to do so after defeating Dovin Baan

citation.text: "Lavinia", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to fight Dovin Baan, letting the real Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, then blinds Baan.
timeline.quote: He disguised himself as Chandra in the fight against Dovin Baan

citation.text: "Lazav", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav and the other guildmasters take part in Nissa's ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: Lazav participated in a ritual led by Nissa to resurrect Niv-Mizzet

citation.text: "Lazav", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to distract Dovin Baan, letting Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, and Lazav defeats Baan.
timeline.quote: Lazav defeated Baan, blinding him with throwing stars and causing him to planeswalk away.

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav, disguised as Saheeli, attends the Planewide Celebration, leaving Teyo to wonder where the real Saheeli is.
timeline.quote: it turned out to be Lazav disguised as her, leaving Teyo to wonder what happened to the real Saheeli

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Teysa takes the reins as Matriarch and allies with Lazav to play her rivals against each other.
timeline.quote: Teysa was content to be the power behind the curtain.

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Matriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret meets Lazav, with whom he has a secret alliance.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret returned to Ravnica to meet with Lazav

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guilds assign Zarek to hunt Tezzeret, Vraska to hunt Dovin Baan, and hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana.
timeline.quote: And Kaya, the ten guilds wish to hire you to assassinate Liliana Vess.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark, Lazav partners with Teysa Karlov to control the Orzhov, has Dovin Baan killed to blackmail Vraska, and partners with Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Lazav had Dovin Baan killed, which allowed the shapeshifter to blackmail Vraska

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Since the New Phyrexian Invasion, Lazav lies low while the guild spreads the lie that he died, secretly assuming the faces of low-rank agents.
timeline.quote: Many Dimir guild members have spread the lie that he died during the invasion.

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etrata tells Proft she will keep serving as his aide because they became friends; she claims Dimir is weak and Lazav dead.
timeline.quote: Etrata told Proft that she had decided to continue serving as his aide

citation.text: "Etrata", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav appears on Thunder Junction, likely to lay low and run the Dimir from the shadows.
timeline.quote: Lazav later appeared on Thunder Junction

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav manipulates the champions into fighting again after Jace stops them momentarily at the Forum of Azor.
timeline.quote: He managed to stop them momentarily, but Lazav appeared and manipulated the champions into fighting once more.

citation.text: "Implicit Maze", section "The race in the maze". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav reveals himself, lets the parents raise the boy under safeguards, sends Grimbly away with memory erased and installs Aunt Bea.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, Lazav revealed himself from the corner where he had been sitting all along.

citation.text: "Merret", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav tries to extract Millena from Niv-Mizzet's claws; her fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: Lazav later made efforts to extract Millena from Niv-Mizzet's claws

citation.text: "Millena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirko becomes convinced Dimir faked its demise and hunts for Lazav to earn his way back in.
timeline.quote: He's become convinced that House Dimir was not truly destroyed during the invasion

citation.text: "Mirko Vosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Saheeli, Lazav and Lavinia enter New Prahv to deactivate the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: intending to deactivate the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "New Prahv", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav, posing as Chandra, blinds Dovin Baan, who planeswalks to safety.
timeline.quote: Lazav blinded Dovin, but as the Immortal Sun was deactivated, Baan managed to planeswalk to safety

citation.text: "New Prahv", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Supreme Verdict foils Lazav's plot and the guilds begin building the Embassy of the Guildpact.
timeline.quote: The Supreme Verdict foiled Lazav ’s plot to weaponize the trial against the other guilds

citation.text: "Supreme Verdict", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit and used it to reestablish House Dimir.
timeline.quote: Lazav , the new guildmaster of House Dimir, claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit

citation.text: "Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav abducts Varryvort and impersonates him to infiltrate the Izzet and eavesdrop on the guild leaders' summit.
timeline.quote: Lazav assumed Varryvort’s form to gain access to the Izzet’s inner circle

citation.text: "Varryvort", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varryvort is found to have been only incapacitated, not killed.
timeline.quote: Thankfully, Varryvort himself was not killed but merely incapacitated during Lazav’s deception.

citation.text: "Varryvort", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vorel completes the Implicit Maze run and arrives at the Forum of Azor, where Lazav instigates chaos.
timeline.quote: He completed the run successfully and showed up at the Forum of Azor

citation.text: "Vorel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Teysa speaks to Lazav about Boros losing angels.
relations.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

citation.text: Urbis Protector (Ravnica: Clue Edition, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: then he will prove himself worthy of rejoining the Dimir

citation.text: "Mirko Vosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Teysa aligned with the Dimir guildmaster.
relations.quote: Having aligned with the Dimir guildmaster Lazav to gain ultimate power

citation.text: "Orzhov Syndicate", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: She joined Lazav to gain ultimate power.
relations.quote: Joining up with the Dimir guildmaster Lazav to gain the ultimate power

citation.text: "Teysa Karlov", section "Matriarch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
